name: trade_finance_settlement_engine
docs: Sovereign Commodity Trade Escrow, Tollgate & Umpire Settlement Engine.
Designed for multi-million dollar critical mineral consignments (Spodumene, Copper, Nickel, Cobalt).
1. In-transit collateral locking with Ed25519 dual-sign enforcement.
2. Mandatory EU TRACES NT Due Diligence Statement (DDS) cryptographic grounding.
3. Automated Umpire Assay Pro-Rata grade settlement (basis points adjustment).
4. In-transit RWA Yield allocation upon customs clearance (Rotterdam, Antwerp, Busan).
5. Sovereign Tollgate: 15 bps (0.15%) protocol fee collection on every trade.
6. Anti-Bypass Gate: Trades lacking verified Oracle attestation face mandatory 5.0% risk forfeiture.

instructions.name: fundConsignmentDeal
docs: Funds a new high-value consignment deal into institutional escrow.
Transfers USDC from buyer to program vault and records initial parameters.

instructions.name: verifyTracesDdsGrounding
docs: Cryptographically grounds the EU TRACES NT DDS record with Copernicus satellite telemetry.

instructions.name: executeCommercialSettlement
docs: Executes dual-assay tolerance arbitration settlement and disburses funds.
Captures 15 bps protocol fee to protocol treasury, distributes pro-rata amounts and RWA yield.

instructions.name: refundConsignmentDeal
docs: Refunds escrowed capital to buyer if customs rejected or severe breach occurs.
